column1: # Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection: Objective contract manifest. Written by `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --pin`;

column8: String → ℕ → List UInt8 → List (String × ℤ)

∀ (stem : String) (kind : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.ResourceKind) (identifier : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.CapabilityId) (left right : Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.Authority), left ⟨Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.AuthorityPlane.capability kind, identifier⟩ = right ⟨Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.AuthorityPlane.capability kind, identifier⟩ → left ⟨Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.AuthorityPlane.revoked, Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.RevocationKey.capability identifier⟩ = right ⟨Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.AuthorityPlane.revoked, Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.RevocationKey.capability identifier⟩ → Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.grantSlots stem kind identifier left = Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.grantSlots stem kind identifier right

∀ (stem : String) (kind : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.ResourceKind) (identifier : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.CapabilityId) (logical : Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.Authority), List.take 2 (Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.grantSlots stem kind identifier logical) = [(ToString.toString stem ++ ToString.toString "/present", if (logical ⟨Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.AuthorityPlane.capability kind, identifier⟩).isSome = Bool.true then 1 else 0), (ToString.toString stem ++ ToString.toString "/revoked", if Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.selfRevoked logical identifier = Bool.true then 1 else 0)]

∀ (stem : String) (kind : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.ResourceKind) (identifier : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.CapabilityId) (logical : Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.Authority) (address : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Address Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.layout) (value : Option (Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.layout.Value address.fst)), address ≠ ⟨Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.AuthorityPlane.capability kind, identifier⟩ → address ≠ ⟨Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.AuthorityPlane.revoked, Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.RevocationKey.capability identifier⟩ → Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.grantSlots stem kind identifier (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store.set logical address value) = Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.grantSlots stem kind identifier logical
